about.title: About SOJIF Consulting
about.subtitle: A firm of excellence serving African businesses
about.historyP1: Founded in Dakar, SOJIF Consulting was born from the conviction that African businesses deserve world-class support, adapted to their realities.
about.historyP2: Under the leadership of Fatou Guewel MBAYE, the firm has developed a unique approach combining legal, financial and technological expertise to offer integrated and tailored solutions.
about.missionDesc: Structure and strengthen the performance of African businesses through high-level multidisciplinary expertise in law, finance and development.
about.visionDesc: Become the reference firm in West Africa for strategic and operational business support, combining excellence, innovation and local presence.
about.value1Desc: We strive for excellence in every intervention, every recommendation, every solution.
about.value2Desc: Transparency and ethics are at the heart of all our professional relationships.
about.value3Desc: We constantly innovate to offer solutions adapted to modern challenges.
about.value4Desc: We are fully committed to the success of each of our clients.
about.directorBio: Expert in business structuring and strategic consulting, Fatou Guewel MBAYE leads SOJIF Consulting with an ambitious vision for supporting African businesses.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the SOJIF Consulting website and requests submitted through its forms, offer pages and contact channels.

section1.title: 1. Definitions
section1.sojifDef: means the consulting firm providing services in business law, taxation, accounting, human resources, strategic advisory, digitalization and recruitment.
section1.userDef: means any person browsing the website or using a contact, diagnostic, recruitment or project request form.
section1.contentDef: means all text, visuals, logos, information, documents and resources published on the website.
section1.servicesDef: means the advisory, support, subscription, recruitment and digitalization services offered by SOJIF Consulting.

section2.title: 2. User obligations
section2.intro: The user agrees to use the website fairly, lawfully and with respect for the rights of SOJIF Consulting and third parties.
section2.item1: Provide accurate information when submitting a form.
section2.item2: Do not use the website to transmit unlawful, fraudulent or malicious content.
section2.item3: Do not attempt to alter the operation, security or availability of the website.
section2.item4: Respect the intellectual property rights attached to published content.

section3.title: 3. Description of services
section3.intro: The website presents SOJIF Consulting's areas of expertise, subscription offers and contact channels.
section3.details: The information published is general in nature and does not, by itself, constitute personalized legal, tax, accounting or HR advice. Each assignment is scoped beforehand and, where appropriate, confirmed through a tailored proposal.

section4.title: 4. Subscriptions and payments
section4.intro: The offers displayed on the website indicate the general conditions applicable to subscriptions and recurring services.
section4.commitment: Unless otherwise agreed, subscriptions are presented on an annual or semiannual basis with the conditions specified on the Offers page.
section4.payment: Payment, deposit, invoicing and renewal terms are confirmed before the effective start of the assignment.
section4.cancellation: Any cancellation, suspension or modification of an assignment must be formalized under the terms agreed between the parties.

section5.title: 5. Intellectual property
section5.intro: The website, its structure, text, graphic elements, logos and content are protected by applicable intellectual property rules.
section5.sojifRights: SOJIF Consulting retains all rights attached to its trademarks, materials, methods, documents and published content.
section5.userLicense: Any unauthorized reproduction, adaptation, distribution or exploitation is prohibited without prior written consent.

section6.title: 6. Liability
section6.intro: SOJIF Consulting makes reasonable efforts to ensure the accuracy and updating of the information published on the website.
section6.damaging: SOJIF Consulting cannot be held liable for inappropriate use of the website, temporary interruption, technical error or indirect damage.
section6.liability: Decisions made by the user based on general website information remain under the user's responsibility until a personalized assignment has been formally agreed.

section7.title: 7. Governing law and jurisdiction
section7.intro: These terms are governed by the laws applicable in Senegal, unless mandatory rules provide otherwise.
section7.jurisdiction: In the event of a dispute, the parties will seek an amicable resolution before referring the matter to the competent courts.

section8.title: 8. Contact
section8.intro: For any question regarding these terms of use, you may contact SOJIF Consulting.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how SOJIF Consulting collects, uses and protects personal data submitted through the website.

section1.title: 1. Data collected
section1.intro: The data collected depends on the forms used and the nature of the request.
section1.personal: Personal data that may be collected
section1.item3: Company name, position, business sector and organization size.
section1.item4: Information about the expressed need, project, budget or contact preference.
section1.item5: Documents voluntarily submitted, especially as part of a job application.

section2.title: 2. Use of data
section2.intro: Data is used only for purposes related to SOJIF Consulting services.
section2.item1: Respond to contact, diagnostic or consultation requests.
section2.item2: Qualify needs and route requests to the right area of expertise.
section2.item3: Manage applications, recruitment requests and professional communications.
section2.item4: Ensure administrative, commercial and operational follow-up of assignments.
section2.item5: Improve the quality of the website, content and user experience.

section3.title: 3. Data protection
section3.intro: SOJIF Consulting implements reasonable measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or disclosure.
section3.details: Access to information is limited to authorized persons and technical providers required for service operation.

section4.title: 4. Data sharing
section4.intro: Data is not sold to third parties.
section4.details: It may be shared with technical providers, partners or authorities when necessary for service delivery, compliance with a legal obligation or defense of SOJIF Consulting's rights.

section5.title: 5. User rights
section5.intro: Subject to applicable rules, users may exercise rights over their personal data.
section5.item1: Request access to personal data held.
section5.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
section5.item3: Request deletion or restriction of processing where possible.
section5.item4: Object to certain processing operations or withdraw consent where consent is required.

section6.title: 6. Cookies and audience measurement
section6.intro: The website may use technical or audience measurement cookies.
section6.details: These tools help ensure proper website operation, analyze usage and improve published content.

section7.title: 7. Personal data contact
section7.intro: For any question regarding your personal data, contact SOJIF Consulting.
